mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, with potential for altered metabolism and increased tamoxifen metabolite levels affecting efficacy; dutasteride may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of tamoxifen.
action: Monitor clinical response to tamoxifen therapy and consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available; assess for tamoxifen efficacy in breast cancer treatment and potential adverse effects from increased metabolite accumulation.
